resolved_via.description: With search: present only when the modelled registry has no live row for the searched ticker and it resolves to the security that holds or most recently held it (e.g. delisted CTRA).

delisted.description: true when the answering security is closed in the security master or flagged delisted in the registry; false when the most-recent-holder pass found it open. Absent when neither source was consulted (ordinary answers).

ticker_reassigned.description: true when the security master shows a different security holding the ticker today that the API cannot serve (no registry row under the ticker, no daily history), so the answer is still the previous holder's series (e.g. FB keeps answering Meta while another security holds FB). Absent otherwise.

current_holder.description: With ticker_reassigned: the security holding the ticker today.
